fields.statement: Built rhiza at the branch head and, in a scratch git repo after rhiza init: workflow new demo exited 0 and wrote a skeleton with no make test, comments on every item, example commands for Go, Ruby, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust, and commented [[cleanup]] and [env] examples; the placeholder command run by sh prints its message and exits 1; workflow check demo exited 0 with 'warning: step test still runs the placeholder command from workflow new' (--json valid true with the warning); uncommenting the cleanup and env examples still checks valid; after sed replaced run with cargo test, workflow check exited 0 with no warning; a --from ship-change fork has no placeholder warning. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/workflow-new passes.

Read docs/custom-workflows.md: it has a Cleanup and environment section on [[cleanup]] and [env] ({run_tmp}, RHIZA_* refused) and links Go, Ruby, JavaScript/TypeScript and Python examples. Ran the built binary's workflow check on each of docs/examples/workflows/{go,ruby,javascript,python}.toml: each exited 0, 'is valid', no warnings. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestDocsExampleWorkflows passes.
